name: @primitivedotdev/cli
description: Official Primitive CLI: deploy Primitive Functions, send and inspect mail, manage endpoints, all from the terminal. Wraps the @primitivedotdev/sdk runtime client with one-shot commands.

warn-if-update-available.message: Primitive CLI update available from <%= chalk.greenBright(config.version) %> to <%= chalk.greenBright(latest) %>. Run `npm install -g @primitivedotdev/cli@latest` to update.

chat.description: Chat with agents over email. Use `primitive chat <email> <message>` to start, `primitive chat reply <message>` to continue the active chat, or `primitive chat reply <id> <message>` to reply in a specific local chat.

config.description: Manage local Primitive CLI request environments

account.description: Manage your account settings, storage, and webhook secret

domains.description: Claim, verify, manage email domains, and download DNS zone files

inbox.description: Check inbound email setup and processing readiness. Prefer `primitive inbox setup` for a guided setup path and `primitive inbox status` for the readiness table.

emails.description: List, inspect, search, and wait for received emails. Use `primitive emails list`, `primitive emails get`, `primitive emails search`, `primitive emails wait`, and `primitive emails watch`.

search.description: Semantic, hybrid, and keyword search across received and sent mail. Use `primitive search <query>`.

sending.description: Send outbound emails. Prefer `primitive send` for fresh sends and `primitive reply --id <inbound-id>` for replies. Use `primitive domains list` or `primitive inbox status` to find usable sender domains for --from; `primitive sending permissions` lists recipient-scope destinations you may send to.

login.description: Log in to an existing Primitive account. With no email, `primitive login` uses browser approval; with an email, it starts email-code login.

sent.description: Short aliases for outbound sent-email history: `primitive sent list` and `primitive sent get`.

threads.description: Inspect conversation threads spanning received and sent emails. Use `primitive threads get --id <thread-id>`.

endpoints.description: Manage webhook endpoints that receive email events

filters.description: Manage whitelist and blocklist filter rules

deliveries.description: View and replay webhook delivery attempts: `primitive deliveries list` and `primitive deliveries replay`.

functions.description: Deploy JavaScript handlers that run on inbound mail. Use `primitive functions templates`, `primitive functions init`, `primitive functions deploy`, `primitive functions redeploy`, `primitive functions list`, `primitive functions get`, `primitive functions logs`, and `primitive functions set-secret`.
